review_method: Downloaded the five latest run-specific ZIP artifacts and technical QA artifact. Visually inspected all five *_review.jpg, all eight source-preview strips per video, and extracted a midpoint MP4 frame for each of the six real Kokoro narration blocks (30 frames). Independently probed MP4 durations, video dimensions and audio streams. Reproduced the turtle freeze using ffmpeg scale=180:-2,freezedetect=n=-45dB:d=1.0. This is editorial QA, not merely GitHub workflow status.
